description: Keep a code project (one or many files) with full version history, private to the paying wallet. Every edit (exact find-and-replace, a line range, add or remove a file) makes a new version with a diff; branch from any version. action=store $0.005 up to 1 MB (then $0.005 per MB), kept 30 days, renewable. edit, get, diff, list, delete $0.0025. Store by POST JSON {files: {"path": "content"}}. Up to 50 MB, 500 files, 500 versions per project. The price depends on the inputs, as described above (USDC on Base, x402); you're only charged when the call succeeds.

action.description: store, edit, get, diff, list, renew, or delete

against.description: Version to compare with (diff; default: the version it was based on)

all.description: 1 = replace every match of find, not just a unique one (edit)

bytes.description: Project size in bytes (store/renew over 1 MB)

end_line.description: Last line to replace (edit by line range)

from.description: Version to build on (default: latest; 0 = original)

start_line.description: First line to replace (edit by line range)

text.description: New text for the line range (edit)

name: code
title: Versioned code workspace (never lose work)
